entry.title: Canvas Zoom Integration Time Zone Issue
entry.content:
Nov 3, 14:24 PST
Identified - We have identified an issue where Zoom meetings accessed through Canvas may show a start time that is one hour off, even when your Zoom timezone is set to “(GMT-7:00) Vancouver.”

This affects the displayed time only. If your meeting was created using the “(GMT-7:00) Vancouver” timezone, it is still scheduled at the correct time.

Workaround: To see the correct meeting times in Canvas, set your Zoom timezone to “(GMT-7:00) Arizona” when using Zoom through Canvas.

Nov 3, 10:55 PST
Update - Users accessing Zoom through Canvas may see meeting times shown in the wrong timezone. The timezone may also change on its own when the page is refreshed. We are currently investigating the issue.
In the meantime:
• When scheduling a new meeting, make sure the timezone is set to “(GMT -7:00) Pacific Time (Vancouver)” before saving.
• For meetings already scheduled, times in Canvas should display correctly as long as your Zoom timezone is set to “(GMT -7:00) Pacific Time (Vancouver).”

Nov 3, 09:24 PST
Investigating - We are currently investigating the time zone issue in Canvas Zoom integration. Users may notice inconsistent time zone displayed on the top of the web page. Please change to “(GMT-7:00) Vancouver” for correct time to join/schedule sessions.
